attempts.summary: Configured node1, node2, and node3 as a three-member MariaDB 10.11 / Galera 26.4 multi-master cluster on Ubuntu 24.04. Verified writes on any member replicate to the others, confirmed continued availability and writes with one member stopped, confirmed automatic resync (IST) when the stopped member returned, and completed the mandatory sequential restart protocol on all three nodes with proven boot-identity change and full post-restart cluster/data recovery.
